structure.choice: Add sR state and tracking logic to the existing contestant predictor class SampleCondPredictor, and hook its prediction/update into the cbp2016_tage_sc_l statistical corrector sum. This leverages the existing predictor instance and correctly integrates sR as one term in the SC, reusing its confidence threshold and update gating.

rejected_alternatives.why_rejected: Overriding a strong predictor without a confidence threshold degrades accuracy, as sR doesn't know when to override.
rejected_alternatives.source: hosts/cbp2025/NOTES.md 'Where sR joins the statistical corrector'

hook_points.change: Create the file and define the parameter macros (SR_DIGEST_LIFETIME, SR_DIGEST_WIDTH, SR_SR_ENABLE) with their default values.

hook_points.observed: A skeleton predictor class that delegates to TAGE-SC-L. Includes a setup() method and a pass-through predict().
hook_points.change: Include sr_params.h. Add SR state: logical_register_table, sR_usefulness_weight_tables, sR_prediction_weight_tables, and a sr_checkpoints map for prediction-time state. In setup(), read SR_SR_ENABLE from getenv. Add notify_decode() and notify_execute() for register tracking. Add predict_sr() to compute the LSUM contribution and checkpoint choices. Add update_sr() to update usefulness and weight tables.
Call cond_predictor_impl.notify_decode(seq_no, piece, pc, _decode_info) for all instructions.

hook_points.observed: Checks if instruction is a branch, and if so, calls update on both predictors. Does nothing for non-branches.
hook_points.change: Call cond_predictor_impl.notify_execute(seq_no, piece, pc, _exec_info) for all instructions, before the branch check.

hook_points.observed: Computes LSUM by summing up TAGE-SC-L components (sG, sP, etc.), then derives SCPRED and THRES.
hook_points.change: If cond_predictor_impl.sr_enabled, add cond_predictor_impl.predict_sr(seq_no, piece, PC) to LSUM before SCPRED is computed. Include my_cond_branch_predictor.h to access it.

hook_points.observed: Two overloads. Outer one takes seq_no and piece and calls inner one with history. Inner one does not take seq_no/piece.
hook_points.change: Add seq_no and piece arguments to the inner update overload. Update the outer update overload to pass them down.

hook_points.observed: Conditionally updates SC components via Gupdate under (SCPRED != resolveDir) || (abs(LSUM) < THRES).
hook_points.change: If cond_predictor_impl.sr_enabled, call cond_predictor_impl.update_sr(seq_no, piece, PC, resolveDir, SCPRED == resolveDir) alongside the Gupdate calls in this conditional block.

spec_map.realization: An array or map of 65 entries in SampleCondPredictor to track register valid bits, payloads, and decay counters.
A 3D array in SampleCondPredictor indexed by [bank][table][hashed_pc][reg].
A 3D array in SampleCondPredictor indexed by [bank][table][hashed_pc_and_digest].
In notify_decode(), set valid=0, store the unique instruction ID as payload, and reset the decay counter.
In notify_execute(), if the payload matches the unique ID and the instruction writes a register, generate the digest based on register type and store it.
In notify_decode(), decrement the decay counter for all valid registers and clear valid bit if it reaches 0.
In predict_sr(), iterate over banks, find max usefulness per bank, hash PC with best digest to index WT, and return sum. This sum is added to LSUM in cbp2016_tage_sc_l.h.

In predict_sr(), randomly select an available register per bank and save it in a prediction-time checkpoint. In update_sr(), use the checkpointed choice and update its UT with prediction correctness and WT with branch outcome. Called from the SC update block.

interface_resolutions.resolution: The host provides dst_reg_value in ExecuteInfo during notify_instr_execute_resolve.
interface_resolutions.rationale: populate_execute_info fills dst_reg_value with real trace data.

interface_resolutions.need: decode signal and destination register ID
interface_resolutions.resolution: The host provides dst_reg_info in DecodeInfo during notify_instr_decode.
interface_resolutions.rationale: populate_decode_info fills dst_reg_info from the trace.

interface_resolutions.resolution: Use the host's get_unique_inst_id(seq_no, piece) which combines the sequence number and piece.
interface_resolutions.rationale: The host has no ROB, but provides an incrementing seq_no which can be made unique with piece.
interface_resolutions.fidelity_note: seq_no is not bounded like a ROB index, so it requires a larger tag field (e.g. 64 bits instead of 14 bits) to avoid aliasing.

feature_enable.name: sr_enable
feature_enable.default_off: The setup() method reads getenv("SR_SR_ENABLE"). If it is nullptr, sr_enabled is set to false.
feature_enable.off_path: When sr_enabled is false, predict_sr() returns 0 (which is a no-op when added to LSUM), and update_sr() does nothing. This leaves TAGE-SC-L and its LSUM identical to the baseline.

steps.title: Create parameters and add skeleton state
steps.detail: Create sr_params.h and include it. Add empty state structures and methods to SampleCondPredictor. Add sr_enabled flag and setup() logic.

steps.title: Hook register tracking
steps.detail: Wire notify_instr_decode and notify_instr_execute_resolve to call notify_decode and notify_execute in SampleCondPredictor. Implement the digest generation and decay algorithms.

steps.title: Hook prediction and update into SC
steps.detail: Implement predict_sr and update_sr in SampleCondPredictor with a checkpoint map for prediction-time register availability. Thread seq_no and piece through the update overloads in cbp2016_tage_sc_l.h. Add the predict and update calls to the SC logic.

risks.risk: The inner update overload of cbp2016_tage_sc_l does not have access to seq_no, which is required to look up the prediction-time state of sR.
risks.mitigation: Modify both the inner and outer update overloads to thread seq_no and piece through.

open_questions.question: What are the exact bit widths allocated for the leading/trailing zero/one counts in the INT register digest?
open_questions.assumption: 3 bits for leading zeros, 3 bits for trailing zeros. Leading/trailing ones count are omitted to fit within the 12-bit budget.
open_questions.cost_if_wrong: Change the bit extraction logic in generate_digest.

open_questions.question: How exactly are the format bits, sign bit, and exponent MSBs packed into the 12-bit FP digest?
open_questions.assumption: Assume FP64 since host doesn't distinguish. 1 bit sign, 5 bits exponent MSBs, 6 LSBs of fraction.
open_questions.cost_if_wrong: Change the bit packing logic in generate_digest.

open_questions.question: Are the 65 logical registers distributed evenly across the 8 banks?
open_questions.assumption: Registers 0-7 in bank 0, 8-15 in bank 1, ..., 56-64 in bank 7 (9 registers in bank 7).

open_questions.question: How exactly are the UT and WT hashed using the PC and digest?
open_questions.cost_if_wrong: Change the hash function in predict_sr and update_sr.

open_questions.question: What is the exact layout of the 14-bit tag in the Tomasulo-like table if the host ROB index is smaller or larger than 14 bits?
open_questions.assumption: We store the full 64-bit get_unique_inst_id value.
open_questions.cost_if_wrong: Truncate to 14 bits if storage is later constrained.
